heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Administrator the following amounts:

tree.text: To carry out this subchapter (except sections 6991b(h), 6991d(c), 6991j, and 6991k of this title) $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2011.

children.text: to carry out section 6991b(h) of this title (except section 6991b(h)(12) of this title) $200,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2011;
to carry out section 6991b(h)(12) of this title, $200,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2011;
to carry out sections 6991b(i), 6991c(f), and 6991d(c) of this title $100,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2011; and
to carry out sections 6991i, 6991j, 6991k, and 6991l of this title $55,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2011.

notes.text: Amendments2006—Par. (2). Pub. L. 109–432 and Pub. L. 109–433 amended par. (2) identically, substituting “Fund” for “Fund, notwithstanding section 9508(c)(1) of title 26” in introductory provisions. Pub. L. 109–168 substituted “2006 through 2011” for “2005 through 2009” wherever appearing.
